refbody.p: Home Device Manager includes the Proactive Management Engine that allows policy-based automation of device configuration and management. The Northbound Interface (NBI) also provides a standardized web services interface for existing OSS infrastructure and integration with other Motive™ products such as Service Management Platform (SMP) and Home Care. In addition, the Traffic Regulation Module (TRM) is an optional module that uses input throttling to regulate massive amounts of traffic data collected from CPEs, the Intelligent Workflow Engine (IWE) extends HDM's proactive management functionalities by allowing service providers to customize service management workflows, and the Generic TR-069 Proxy offers the capability to communicate and manage non-TR-069 devices. As a key benefit to providers, Home Device Manager enables single as well as large-scale bulk device configuration, troubleshooting, firmware upgrades, event management, alarm management, and user management.
